source.name: Digitální technická mapa Prahy a Středočeského kraje / veřejné ZPS

coordinateTransform.description: ČÚZK table_-y-x_3_v1710 projected grid, then Inverse of Modified Krovak East North (Greenwich) + S-JTSK/05 to WGS 84 (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)

selection: Forest (0100000211) and tree/shrub groups (0100000215, TypUdrzovaneZelene 3) intersecting 300 m of the PID shape; complete polygons
limitations: Individual trees inside these areas are not surveyed; the scene plants an estimated stand.
